listing.title: Skill listing
listing.description: {{agent}} lists each skill's name and description in every conversation, within a budget of about 1% of its context window. An estimate from its documented rules.
listing.counts: {{full}} with a description · {{nameOnly}} by name only · {{hidden}} hidden from the model
listing.over: About {{over}} characters over. {{agent}} cuts the descriptions of the skills used least, so they may stop being picked. Shorten the biggest descriptions below, or set disable-model-invocation: true on skills you only call by name.
listing.fits: It fits. {{agent}} shows every listed description in full.
listing.windowHint: Set this to the window of the model you use. A 1M window has five times the budget.
listing.cutHint: Its description is longer than {{agent}} keeps, so the end is cut.
